insights.title: ₹46L Revenue at Immediate Stockout Risk
insights.description: 15 SKUs face stockout within 3-7 days across 5 store clusters, driven by salary effect and early Eid preparation. Top 5 actions alone cover ₹16.7L exposure requiring 1,267 units replenishment.
insights.action: Expedite emergency replenishment orders to STR-0013 (3.2 days cover) and STR-0001 (+47% demand spike) within 24 hours to prevent revenue loss

insights.title: 58 SKUs Unprepared for Eid in 20 Days
insights.description: Critical event readiness gap with Eid al-Adha approaching. Festival prep demand already 12% above forecast in affected categories, but majority of event SKUs lack inventory ramp-up.
insights.action: Immediately trigger Eid ramp-up protocol for all 58 SKUs, prioritizing Grocery & Staples and Snacks categories with proven festival velocity patterns

insights.title: Dairy & Beverages Miss 14% Accuracy Target
insights.description: Dairy & Frozen (14.4% MAPE) and Beverages (14.9% MAPE) significantly underperform vs Grocery/Personal Care (8.7%). Recent anomalies show weather and competitor impacts not captured by models.
insights.action: Enhance forecast models for Dairy/Beverages with weather APIs and competitor OOS signals; increase safety stock by 15% until accuracy improves

insights.title: Capture ₹5.7L Competitor Spillover Demand
insights.description: Competitor stockouts near STR-0053 creating sustained demand spillover opportunity. Early salary effect (+62% deviation) and cannibalization patterns show model is learning external demand drivers.
insights.action: Deploy additional 103 units to STR-0053 cluster and activate competitive monitoring dashboards for 10 high-traffic stores to capitalize on ongoing market share gains
